title: whisplab: a frame-level multi-task Transformer for automatic guitar tablature transcription
description:
whisplab maps electric guitar audio to a dense tablature representation, jointly predicting per-string fret labels, note onsets, and eleven playing techniques at frame level. A multi-scale convolutional front-end over log-scaled Constant-Q Transform spectrograms feeds an eight-layer Pre-LN Transformer encoder with independent per-string heads.

Trained on the GOAT dataset, the system reaches a note-level F1 of 0.70 on the held-out test split. The repository also contains the improvisation case study, in which the model's output is compared against a hand transcription of an unconstrained 26-second improvised solo — the only setting in which performed string assignments are known, and therefore the only direct measurement of tablature rather than pitch quality.

Reference implementation for the bachelor's thesis Automatic Guitar Tablature Transcription with a Multi-Task Transformer, Johannes Kepler University Linz, 2026.
